details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and its index.js also invokes the same beacon when the module is loaded, so installing or importing it sends a single HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package: @ppa-web-components/ppa-searchform. The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, and the npm/node user agent string. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and the module otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the real package name do not fail. The package describes itself as an authorized dependency-confusion test and reports only that it was installed.
